name: ai-voice-bridge
stderr:
[voice-bridge] WARNING: No audio player detected.
  Voice Bridge requires mpv, ffplay, or another audio player to produce sound.
  The MCP server will start, but speak commands will fail silently.

  Install an audio player:
  Ubuntu/Debian: sudo apt install mpv   (or: sudo apt install ffmpeg)
  Fedora/RHEL:   sudo dnf install mpv
  Arch:          sudo pacman -S mpv

[voice-bridge] WARNING: No display server or PulseAudio detected -- this may be a headless environment.
  TTS audio playback requires a machine with speakers or audio output.
  Remote sessions (SSH, containers, CI) typically cannot play audio.

[voice-bridge] ERROR: voice-bridge-mcp is not installed and no install path is available.

  Install uv (recommended): 
  curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh
  Or:  brew install uv  (macOS)
  Then re-run this command.

  Or install manually with pip into a venv:
    python3 -m venv ~/.voice-bridge-env
    ~/.voice-bridge-env/bin/pip install 'ai-voice-bridge[edge,mcp]'
    Then point your MCP client at ~/.voice-bridge-env/bin/voice-bridge-mcp
